$comment: Canonical reward-ladder definition for the CRISP gamification system.
Five surfaces consume this file (see scripts/sync-tier-config.mjs):
• Server-side promotion logic lives in backend/app/api/endpoints/reports.py::_recompute_tier; it does NOT read this file (promotion thresholds are code, not metadata).

If you change emoji / label / color, run `node scripts/sync-tier-config.mjs` to regenerate platform-native copies (`shared/tier-config.{js,ts}`) and verify with `node scripts/sync-tier-config.mjs --check` in CI.

T2_SIGNAL is the one-time participation badge. Submitting 50 reports does NOT push you past T2; only an analyst action (dispatch/resolve → T3) or a downstream impact event (lives_saved ≥ 1 → T4) advances the tier.

tiers.label: Signal
tiers.criterion: ≥1 report submitted (any status) - one-time participation badge

tiers.label: Changemaker
tiers.criterion: ≥1 report dispatched (RESPONDING or RESOLVED) - analyst action required

tiers.label: Lifekeeper
tiers.criterion: sum(lives_impacted) ≥ 1 across the device's reports - downstream impact required

legacy_aliases.$comment: Pre-V4 badge_level values mapped to the V4 ladder. Used by clients that fetch /profile from a backend mid-rollout where the device row still carries the legacy value. NEVER surfaces as the dashboard's reporter_tier (the Phase 1.6 join filters to V4 ids only - see _attach_reporter_tier).
